headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: Daniel Garcia vs. Wheeler Yuta etched their names into history in the first-ever ROH Pure Title match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.98 ? a good, competitive contest. Garcia forced Yuta to tap in his own hometown of Buffalo to win the ROH Pure Championship, then stood arm in arm with Yuta's Blackpool Combat Club stablemates as a furious Chris Jericho looked on from the ramp.

Flash back to 2024, when the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Will Ospreay vs. PAC went to war, appearing on All Out, rated 9.25 ? an incredible outing. Ospreay survived Pac's full arsenal, hitting a Styles Clash into a second Hidden Blade to retain the International Championship in one of the night's standout matches.

Turning the clock back to 2022: it was title-change night for the AEW World Trios Titles as Death Triangle vs. Best Friends & Cassidy battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.41 ? a well-worked match ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. For Death Triangle and Best Friends & Cassidy, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. With both the World and Trios titles vacated after the All Out fallout, Death Triangle beat Best Friends and a game Orange Cassidy to become new AEW World Trios Champions the very next Dynamite.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2022, the ROH World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Claudio Castagnoli vs. Dax Harwood went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 8.15 ? one of the better matches of the year. Dax Harwood was challenging for gold for the very first time. Castagnoli survived a piledriver and a flurry of German suplexes from Harwood before locking in the Sharpshooter for the tap-out, extending his unbeaten run since joining AEW that June.

On a Saturday in 2024, back when Adam Page vs. Swerve Strickland settled things in a Lights Out Steel Cage match, serving as the night's main event on All Out, rated 9.09 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype, on an outstanding All Out '24 show that earned an overall rating of 9.19. In a brutal Lights Out Steel Cage match that finally settled a year-long blood feud, Page choked out Strickland with the ring bell rope, leaving him laid out in the cage as the show closed.

On a Saturday in 2024, back when Kazuchika Okada vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Mark Briscoe vs. Orange Cassidy fought tooth and nail for the AEW Continental Title, appearing on All Out, rated 7.22 ? a match that delivered. It was the 10th time the AEW Continental Title had been on the line, a notable milestone for the title. In a four-way loaded with three former or future champions, Okada slipped past Takeshita and Briscoe to plant a Rainmaker on Cassidy and retain the Continental Championship.
